caveat: A literature-informed sensitivity range, not an industry standard, confidence interval or a physical no-slip tolerance. Our persistent material patch/source-stationary masks differ from published metrics. 15 cm/s is an interpolation for sensitivity only; 0.1 s is our local persistence filter.

sources.title: PHUMA: Physically-grounded Humanoid Locomotion Dataset, section 3.2
sources.detail: Non-Skating is the percentage of contact frames with horizontal foot-region velocity below 10 cm/s, using heel/toe contact scores. This is a frame metric, not a clip failure rule.

sources.title: NVIDIA Kimodo official benchmark metrics
sources.detail: foot_skate_ratio uses toe speed above 0.2 m/s with toe height below 0.05 m at consecutive frames. The separate 0.15 m/s contact consistency threshold is not a foot-skating tolerance.

sources.title: Disney Research: Factorized Motion Diffusion, appendix B, Foot Skating Ratio
sources.detail: Uses heels within 5 cm of the floor and lateral speed above 7.5 cm/s, reporting a frame fraction. This is an additional stricter animation reference.
